core_conditions.description: Automatic lighting is requested (AutoLightOnReq_1 = 0x1) and rear fog lights are not active (vehRLsType = 0).
The sunlight and rain sensor has switched from night mode to day mode.
The rear fog lights are explicitly turned off.
Specific combinations of user and vehicle modes must be met: [1&2]||[3&4]||5.

core_outputs.description: User mode set to XOTA (eXtended Over-The-Air update).
